steps.input:
n=30
G=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for k in range(11):
    c=5 if k%2==0 else 2
    a=1+k; b=25-k
    for j in range(a,b+1): G[a][j]=G[b][j]=c
    for i in range(a,b+1): G[i][a]=G[i][b]=c
print('{"action": "submit", "grid": '+str(G).replace(' ', '')+'}')
